policy.compatibility: Lumen 4 may deliberately replace v3 component and binary contracts. Consumer data, privacy, and release approval remain protected. Migration guidance documents externally visible changes.
policy.versioning: Prepare the coordinated v4 candidate locally. Publication requires separate approval of the final reviewed revision through the existing GitHub release workflow.

changes.currentContract: Consumers carry chart-label, hidden-state, clipboard, date-selection, and native-layout workarounds across older Lumen releases.
changes.replacement: Shared chart geometry and formatted axes, strict range selection, explicit clipboard recovery, accessible native layout controls, and a cross-framework image comparison primitive.
changes.migration: Use stable unique chart X identities; remove verified old chart/hidden patches; review button content selectors and loading activation; rebuild native consumers for changed initializer and formatter contracts.

changes.currentContract: Six v3 Swift initializer signatures do not expose compact chart, slider-label, and symbol-selection options.
changes.replacement: Defaulted parameters provide bare chart frames, explicit plot height, optional slider headings, contextual symbol tint, and selection completion.
changes.migration: Rebuild consumers against v4. Existing source calls generally retain defaults; method references and binary clients must adopt the new signatures. See native composition examples.
